description: reporting — inject the lean-reporting output contract on every prompt (per-repo override: REPORT_CONTRACT_FILE → .agent/output-contract.md → .claude/output-contract.md), quote back any text written between tool calls and re-pulse the contract every Nth tool call, and block a contract-violating final message at Stop (forcing a compact rewrite). Kill-switch: REPORT_GUARD_OFF=1 (silences inject, pulse, and Stop guard); REPORT_REACT_OFF=1 (the quote-back only).

hooks.command: python3 "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/contract.py" || echo '⚠️ brevity-reminder DISARMED — hook failed to execute.'
python3 "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/contract-pulse.py" 2>/dev/null || echo '{"systemMessage":"⚠️ contract-pulse DISARMED — hook failed to execute."}'
